rows.title: Unsecured demand grid promissory note: up to $100M line of credit from Applied Digital
rows.detail: Unsecured Demand Grid Promissory Note with Applied Digital Corporation (parent, ~96% owner): line of credit up to $100,000,000 minus any credit support provided by the lender or its affiliates; prepayable at any time without penalty (8-K Item 1.01).
